angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Multitasking makes it hard to pay attention to one thing.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Multitasking reduces focus and attention.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Multitasking causes mental fatigue and lowers productivity.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Multitasking causes mental fatigue and lowers productivity.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Multitasking significantly reduces sustained attention, causing individuals to miss key details due to frequent task switching.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Multitasking significantly reduces sustained attention, causing individuals to miss key details due to frequent task switching.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: It increases the cognitive load on working memory because the brain must rapidly allocate resources between disparate activities, leading to mental fatigue.

modelPlan.focus: Analyze the negative impacts of multitasking on focus and performance by exploring cognitive load, task switching, and diminished concentration.
keyArguments: Multitasking increases cognitive load, leading to reduced efficiency.
Task switching disrupts focus, resulting in lower productivity.
